query: SELECT json_build_object('matchingDirectoryRows',(SELECT count(*) FROM sessions.session_directory WHERE org_id=$1 AND workspace_id=$2 AND session_id=$3),'indexCanonicalSessionIdPresent',(SELECT bool_or(canonical_session_id IS NOT NULL) FROM sessions.session_index WHERE org_id=$1 AND workspace_id=$2 AND session_id=$3),'indexCanonicalMachineIdPresent',(SELECT bool_or(canonical_machine_id IS NOT NULL) FROM sessions.session_index WHERE org_id=$1 AND workspace_id=$2 AND session_id=$3))
queryExecution: psql -U postgres -d hoopdb in local postgres-0; parameters substituted as SQL string literals
